apps.name: Notepad++
apps.install: Run apply-cyclorama-dawn.ps1 (copies XMLs + sets Custom Dark Mode) or copy *.xml to %APPDATA%\Notepad++\themes\
installSteps: Close Notepad++ so it does not overwrite `config.xml` on exit.

Run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File apps/notepad-plus-plus/apply-cyclorama-dawn.ps1` (or `steel` / `day`). The script copies all three `.xml` files into `%APPDATA%\Notepad++\themes\`, writes a one-time `config.xml.pre-rfs.bak` backup, and configures Notepad++ 8.x Custom Dark Mode (`colorTone="32"`) or Day light mode.
Alternatively, copy `Cyclorama Dawn.xml`, `Cyclorama Steel.xml`, and `Cyclorama Day.xml` into `%APPDATA%\Notepad++\themes\` and select the theme in **Settings -> Style Configurator**.

installSteps: Choose a variant folder (`apps/qbittorrent/cyclorama-dawn/`, `cyclorama-steel/`, or `cyclorama-day/`) containing `config.json` and `stylesheet.qss`.

**qBittorrent 5.x (recommended, no `rcc` needed):** Open Tools -> Options -> **Behavior** -> enable **Use custom UI theme** -> select `config.json` directly (`FolderThemeSource` automatically loads sibling `stylesheet.qss` alongside `colors.dark` / `colors.light`).
**qBittorrent 4.x legacy:** Bundle `stylesheet.qss` and `config.json` into a `.qbtheme` resource file with Qt `rcc`, select it under Behavior -> Use custom UI theme, and restart qBittorrent.
